svg.title: Microscopic medium
svg.desc: Three identical asymmetric domains with rounded corners contain periodic two-phase microstructures at epsilon equal to one, one half, and one quarter. The phases are labelled inclusion a1 and matrix a2. There is no homogenization arrow.
